title: Confirmatory retest of the per-crop identity arm on real-match LOTO
status: PRE-REGISTERED -- written before any real-match computation for this arm

arm.name: solver_retest
arm.description: Stage-2 identity MILP (generator.identity_solve) consuming per-crop OCR evidence at the frozen 0.85-floor rule, at the DEV-tuned abstention regime.
build_commands: python -m tools.identity_carrier --arm solver --names-dir outputs/identity/solver_retest --out-root outputs/identity_carrier_retest --json-out results/identity_carrier_retest.json

dev_selection.data: SoccerNet-GSR DEV-20 (eval.gsr_identity.split_sequences -> sorted(seqs)[::3]); TEST-38 not touched
dev_selection.criterion: maximise the arm's OWN named-row coverage subject to its OWN row-weighted jersey precision >= 0.85; the arm's own operating point is used (not a post-hoc posterior threshold) because a real match carries no ground truth with which to calibrate a threshold
dev_selection.greedy_vs_solver: greedy Stage-1 rule on the same per-crop evidence and the same DEV bundles scores coverage 0.3675 at precision 0.8425 -- higher coverage but BELOW the 0.85 floor, so it does not qualify and the solver arm is registered. The margin is 0.0075 of precision: a knife-edge, recorded as such.

hypothesis: The registered arm (Stage-2 solver, per-crop evidence, sim_none 0.92, r_abstain 0.05) achieves HIGHER paired leave-one-group-out top-1 gallery accuracy than the tau = 0.040 Stage-1 connector control, on the three labelled matches (manutd_liverpool, manutd_tottenham, manutd_brighton), graded by the anchor-truth grader of tools.gta_carrier.loto_query_hits.

test.statistic: exact McNemar (binomial test on discordant pairs, p0 = 0.5)
test.multiplicity: none -- this is a single pre-registered comparison. Any other arm or control the same driver emits (baseline, tau0.000) is reference only and no verdict is read off it.
test.grader: tools.gta_carrier.loto_query_hits UNMODIFIED: queries are gallery crops whose SOURCE tracklet carries a close-up-anchor OCR read, graded against that anchor's player name -- never the name the arm assigned.

denominator_rule: Paired on the exact query keys (match, chunk, src_track, frame) present in BOTH the arm's and the control's hit dictionaries. The test denominator is the number of DISCORDANT pairs (control_only_right + arm_only_right) among those shared keys; concordant pairs are dropped, as McNemar requires. Unpaired per-arm rates are reported but are NOT the test.
stopping_rule: ONE run. The verdict is read once, from the p-value of the single comparison above. No second attempt, no re-tuning after seeing the result. If it fails, the failure is the finding.
declared_bias: The control labels its gallery from the same close-up anchor chain that defines the truth; the registered arm's names come from per-crop OCR + the MILP and never see the anchor chain. The test is therefore biased AGAINST the registered arm, as in results/OCR_REALMATCH.md section 0.
report_only_no_claims: the 78-moment carrier factorisation for the registered arm (23 usable naming moments; GTA_LINK_STAGE1 A4 pre-declared it cannot resolve anything below ~0.25)
named-track coverage on the three matches (no per-track ground truth exists, so no precision)
ordering_evidence: At the moment this file was written, no artifact for the registered arm existed: outputs/identity/solver_retest/, outputs/identity_carrier_retest/, results/identity_match_solver_retest.json, results/identity_carrier_retest.json and results/retest_loto.json are all absent. Their mtimes will postdate this file.
